# Support

Start with the [documentation index](../docs/README.md).

Use a GitHub issue for a reproducible emulator, build, installation,
achievements-memory, or HD-renderer problem. Include:

- MesenCE Libretro version or commit
- RetroArch version
- operating system and CPU
- NES or FDS content type
- whether an HD pack is enabled
- exact reproduction steps
- relevant logs
- expected and actual behavior

Do not attach ROMs, BIOS files, copyrighted HD-pack assets, account
credentials, or private data.
